invariants.rationale: The method accepts MapProperties as a parameter and will likely require it to be non-null for correct operation.
If element is null, properties must still be usable, as properties is used regardless of element's value.
The method iterates over element, so if element is not null, it must be iterable, which in libGDX JsonValue typically means it is an array or object.
If element is not null, its name field is checked, so name() must be safe to call.
If properties is not empty, it must have a non-negative size; this is a basic property of containers.
